author: /root
disposition: The isolated coordinator-authored harness passes independent source and focused in-memory review. Its exact candidate bytes may be integrated only after rechecking the captured production baseline. This review approves neither the separate Time/Gravity implementation candidates nor a hardware result.

registered_scope.panel_order: Actual Scale 0 registry currently yields Gravity then Time. Assertions compare sorted identities/preparations and reject duplicates; the program does not prescribe panel order.
registered_scope.candidate_identity: Required lowercase 64-hex value in FTD_AUDIT_CANDIDATE_ID, embedded in the report.
registered_scope.identity_boundary: Shape validation does not verify source binding. A distinct complete source/artifact freeze, independent pre-run identity check and post-run hash reconciliation are still required.

new_behavior: Adds time-gravity-v4 as a panels-only profile requiring the full ordered 33,97 invocation and candidate identity.
Selects exactly the registered Time and Gravity identities/preparations and verifies the resulting plan.
Uses the new dated output prefix and enables the existing post-stop raw frame/callback retention.
For time-gravity-v4 only, the final assertion displays failed row identities/states and reasons rather than dumping full raw vectors.

other_checks: Same owner/load generation, authoritative WASM readiness and qualification
Lifecycle equality and safe advancing owner clock while playing
Correct panel mount before and after paired actions
unchanged_gates.callback_accounting: Only standalone method:ownerRead.* diagnostics are excluded from the callback gate. Nested owner reads remain in inclusive interface callback timings.

compact_failure_display.scope: The mapping changes final assertion display only. The same row-count assertion and report.errors assertion remain; saved JSON and attachments retain every field and raw vector.

raw_timing_contract.boundary: The unchanged probe retains its already reviewed stop/drain/try-finally behavior. This review checks the option selection and unchanged bytes; it does not rerun that probe fault suite or launch a browser.

independent_checks.controlled_execution: Node vm/new Function execution of extracted actual draft/baseline source blocks with mocked environment, assertions and filesystem output. Uses the actual current panel registry. No browser, permanent regression test or hardware process was launched.
invalid_admission_scope: Missing, short, long, uppercase, nonhex, newline-suffixed and whitespace-prefixed candidate identities
independent_checks.legacy_equivalence: 324 combinations compare both acceptance/results and rejection messages with the baseline; four actual-registry panel selections match. Five profile mappings preserve baseline full-row assertion objects except the new v4 display projection. Ten mocked output cases verify five creates and five no-overwrite rejections.

preregistration_review.scope: The program consistently separates Time presentation, Gravity observation batching and hardware acceptance. This is a contract review, not certification that either implementation satisfies it.
preregistration_review.gravity_batch_amendment: One to three copied selectors share one publication pin, one full-volume maximum using the retained mag*mag scan and initial 1e-30, and owned slabs in caller order. Quantity-change refresh requests all three planes together. sampleTick remains null, failures release pins, unsupported direct paths retain their previous full-volume path. These are explicit implementation obligations for its separate independent review.
preregistration_review.time_boundary: Formulas, complete histories, sample requests, controls, source resets and cadence remain acceptance requirements for the Time implementation reviewer.
preregistration_review.evidence_retention: Requires complete raw frame/callback/action samples, reports and failure attachments; immediate archive before another Playwright invocation on success or failure; then independent statistics and source/artifact reconciliation.
preregistration_review.epistemic_boundary: No reference observer optimization, harness result or matched owner clock establishes strict physical recovery or common microscopic observation time. Prior Wave/Spectrum and broader recovery blockers remain open.

remaining_gates: Independently accept the separate Time and Gravity implementation drafts, returning any fixes to their authors.
Recheck this exact baseline immediately before controlled harness integration.
Freeze a separately identified complete integrated candidate and immutable preregistration/review snapshots.
Independently verify the candidate identity before running all 16 registered hardware rows serially.
Preserve full evidence, reconstruct retained statistics and reconcile post-run source/archive hashes without retuning thresholds.
limitations: Controlled source execution establishes admission and report behavior, not browser scheduling, timing, hardware performance or physics.
Candidate identity admission validates shape only; artifact binding remains a separate freeze/post-run gate.
Output paths are size-specific and the runtime still permits only its registered exact panel plans; malformed external payloads beyond these harness inputs were not exhaustively enumerated.
Existing legacy profile behavior is preserved, including their broader size options; no new legacy acceptance restriction is introduced.
